title: Rusted in 2 months
text:
Rusted in 2 months. Rusted within 2 months

I washed this once. Destroyed with rust. I’ve had many swing-aways over the years and loved them. This is a mess.

product_metadata.title: Swing-A-Way 407RD Can Opener, 8.5 inches, Red
features: DURABLE ALL-STEEL CONSTRUCTION: This can opener is one you can rely on to get through tough can tops effortlessly. The body is constructed out of extremely durable steel.

EASY TO USE WITH COMFORTABLE HANDLE: The Swing-A-Way Can Opener features an extra-long crank handle for a better grip; helping take the strain and pain from your hands when in use. The crank folds down, making storage easy.
CUSHION GRIP INCLUDED: There are extra-long soft cushion grips for comfortable handling, the ergonomic handles fit any size hands.

SMOOTH AND EASY USAGE: The cutting wheel is made of high-carbon and glides easily across the tops of cans. The cutting is smooth and skip-proof making usage easy. A built-in bottle opener is included.
EASY TO CLEAN: It is recommended to hand wash with warm water and a mild detergent; rinse then dry immediately.
description: Since 1938, Swing-A-Way  has created the highest quality, most dependable can openers on the market. Soon to become one of your go-to kitchen gadgets, it's comfortable to hold and compact for easy storage. When you reach for a Swing-A-Way, you reach for a classic. This Swing-A-Way Portable Can Opener is extremely durable, with an all-steel construction. Soft cushion-grips for ensure a comfortable grip while opening various cans. A high-carbon, gear-driven cutting wheel and skip-proof feed for smooth and easy usage. Features an integrated bottle opener on the side. No need to purchase a separate bottle opener - now you can have two kitchen tools in one! Quickly and easily remove bottle caps in one swift movement. Hand wash with warm water and a mild detergent, rinse and dry immediately. Measures 8.5-inch long..
